description: Adds, updates and removes project deploy keys.

parameters.name: api_job_token
parameters.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_oauth_token
parameters.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

parameters.name: can_push
parameters.description: Whether this key can push to the project. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: ID or Full path of project in the form of group/name.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: When present the deploy key is added to the project if it does not exist. When absent it is removed from the project if it exists. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: "Adding a project deploy key"
  community.general.gitlab_deploy_key:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ api_token }}"
    project: "my_group/my_project"
    title: "Jenkins CI"
    state: present
    key: "ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAABJQAAAIEAiPWx6WM4lhHNedGfBpPJNPpZ7yKu+dnn1SJejgt4596k6YjzGGphH2TUxwKzxcKDKKezwkpfnxPkSMkuEspGRt/aZZ9w..."

- name: "Update the above deploy key to add push access"
  community.general.gitlab_deploy_key:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ api_token }}"
    project: "my_group/my_project"
    title: "Jenkins CI"
    state: present
    can_push: true

- name: "Remove the previous deploy key from the project"
  community.general.gitlab_deploy_key:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ api_token }}"
    project: "my_group/my_project"
    state: absent
    key: "ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAABJQAAAIEAiPWx6WM4lhHNedGfBpPJNPpZ7yKu+dnn1SJejgt4596k6YjzGGphH2TUxwKzxcKDKKezwkpfnxPkSMkuEspGRt/aZZ9w..."

return_values.name: error
return_values.description: The error message returned by the GitLab API. Returned: failed Sample: "400: key is already in use"

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Success or failure message. Returned: always Sample: "Success"

return_values.name: result
return_values.description: JSON-parsed response from the server. Returned: always
